RULES: No implicit delegation from title, participation, technical qualification or role authentication
No transitive delegation or subdelegation; delegate cannot delegate onward
Each of normative approval, native qualification execution and evidence capture requires explicit delegated power; rights are not inferred from one another
Delegate scope/version/subject/operations must be exact, no wildcard execution
Delegation grants no external/system/production privileges or security bypass
Delegation source and actual issuer power must be outside the delegate's own proposed grant
Owner retains charter/version amendment, supersession and revocation authority; a qualification delegation does not amend this charter
Revocation/expiration/effective status must be checked before each use; uncertainty denies activation
No retroactive promotion or mutation of historical records

EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY.DURABILITY: Only assurance established by selected native contract; file fsync, immutable publication, directory durability, writer termination and cold restore are distinct. No implied general crash durability.
EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY.NATIVE_IDENTITIES: Preserve complete existing kind/namespace/hash domain, source/policy pins, occurrence versus Snapshot/content distinctions, ordered native history and exact canonical bytes. Do not fabricate events for logical calculations.
EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY.POLICY: Explicit evidence mandate and exact artifacts/paths/identity/provenance/observer boundaries required. Native state application is not persisted occurrence capture; handoff does not establish writer exit.

EXCLUSIONS: Authority to bypass organizational security controls
Automatic approval of prospective qualification scenarios

GOVERNING_AUTHORITY.PERMITTED_GOVERNANCE_DOMAIN: Qualification policy only, within actual owner-controlled resources/permissions
GOVERNING_AUTHORITY.ROLE_BASIS: Explicit initiating owner declaration supplied in work package65

IDENTITY_AND_PROVENANCE.APPROVAL_RULE: Actual owner decision references exact charter content identity/version and owner-declaration/evidence; its identity is not included in charter content
IDENTITY_AND_PROVENANCE.AUTHORITY_ROOT: Initiating owner declaration and actual resource permissions are outside this charter; charter does not authorize itself or prove ownership beyond declared scope
IDENTITY_AND_PROVENANCE.CONTENT_IDENTITY_RULE: Canonical compact sorted-key UTF-8 JSON of this immutable content; identity wrapper/lifecycle/approval/issuance records excluded
IDENTITY_AND_PROVENANCE.GRANT_RULE: Qualification grant independently binds effective charter, exact issuer/delegation, subject/operations and actual decision evidence; neither grant hash nor draft creates permission
IDENTITY_AND_PROVENANCE.LIFECYCLE_RULE: Append-only transition identities depend on content, actor/decision evidence and prior lifecycle record, never backwards on a future transition

LIFECYCLE_POLICY.MULTI_TRANSITION_DECISION: One authenticated owner decision may expressly acknowledge review, approve and make effective; create three ordered records referencing the same decision and distinct predecessor links. No selection or record is created now.
LIFECYCLE_POLICY.ORDER_RULE: Append-only explicit transitions; no skipped state, implicit transitive approval, backdating or proposal-as-authority. DRAFT is recorded under the preparation request; all later transitions require explicit authority evidence.

TRANSITIONS.ACTOR: Project owner or separately explicitly designated charter reviewer
TRANSITIONS.EVIDENCE: Exact charter digest/version, reviewer identity or role designation, independent qualification report pin, explicit review acknowledgement; preparation/test PASS alone is not a transition

TRANSITIONS.ACTOR: Project owner acting under the initiating declaration
TRANSITIONS.EVIDENCE: Authenticated explicit charter approval of exact digest/version, scope and exclusions; no inferred selection
Explicit effective/adoption boundary for same approved digest/version; record distinct ordered transition even if one decision expressly includes approval and activation
Explicit successor version/digest approved and made effective, predecessor reference and effective boundary; preserve old charter/grants/evidence unchanged
Explicit revocation record naming charter digest/version, boundary and dependent-grant disposition; do not rewrite historical validity

CONDITIONS: Owner issuer within actual resources/permissions, or exact delegate explicitly empowered for each included mandate
Each normative, execution and evidence section has exact subject/version/pins/boundaries and separate explicit approval, not a blanket or inferred grant
Execution activation is conditional on prior normative scope approval and all technical/environment/issuer gates; evidence operations need their own explicit permission
Approval/adoption is not evidence of execution; execution permission does not amend normative scope
MANDATE_COMPOSITION.SEPARATE_SEQUENTIAL_GRANTS: Required when issuing power or any explicit mandate section/approval cannot cover all scopes in one instrument; no automatic combination or inheritance

NORMATIVE_QUALIFICATION_AUTHORITY.FROZEN_ACCEPTANCE: No silent modification. Any proposed amendment must be separately identified/versioned with exact before/after clauses, assurance effects, owner approval and immutable preservation of original obligations/evidence; execution may not weaken or substitute its oracle to pass.
NORMATIVE_QUALIFICATION_AUTHORITY.POLICY: Prospective scenarios, normative rules, coverage boundaries and acceptance interpretations require explicit scoped approval. Technical design/verification is not adoption.

ACTIVATION_PRECONDITIONS: effective charter and actual issuer/direct or delegated authority
explicit normative scope approval where required
sealed exact inputs, independent full expected outputs, protection and failure/retry rules
exact qualified executable/invocation/environment and actual resource/security permissions
explicit execution/evidence permissions and current effective/lifecycle status
QUALIFICATION_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY.FAIL_CLOSED: Stop on unknown scope, missing input/approval, mismatch, unqualified executable or failed comparison. No automatic retry or additional variant; retry only under its exact explicit bounded permission from approved immutable starting state.
QUALIFICATION_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY.POLICY: Explicit bounded qualification execution grant required; issuer must be owner under effective charter or exact delegate with this power. Charter effectiveness/normative approval is not an execution grant.

RESOURCE_AND_SECURITY_BOUNDARY.DOMAIN: Only actual project-owner-controlled resources and permissions
RESOURCE_AND_SECURITY_BOUNDARY.UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_PERMISSION: Deny activation; obtain actual applicable permission, not a charter inference

VERSIONING.CHANGES: Every change requires new exact version/content digest and explicit owner review/approval/effectiveness. Never select newest file by date. Historical instruments/evidence remain immutable.
VERSIONING.OLD_GRANT_HANDLING: Do not silently rewrite/rebind old grants to a new version. Exact prospective continuation/migration requires owner-specified disposition; historical validity assessed under original authority.

IDENTITY_RULE: Hash only CHARTER_CONTENT using canonical compact sorted UTF-8 JSON, excluding this report wrapper and future approval/lifecycle/grant evidence
